evidence_excerpts: A strongly modular network, consisting of three modules of eight strongly interconnected elements each, yields Φ = 20 bits for each of its three modules.
The large complex encompassing all the elements has an extremely low Φ value of 5 bits.
text: Strongly modular neural architectures can be computationally sophisticated yet contribute little to consciousness because they generate many small low-Φ complexes rather than one high-Φ complex.
